messages:
maria.g: Heads up — after rolling PR #3241 (dynamic-kernel-priority) to canary we see a reproducible throughput regression on L40S with FP8 enabled. Throughput down ~12% and p99 up ~30ms on long-seq workloads.
aj: ack, can you paste the perf numbers and the workload config?
tomo: is this only L40S or H100 too?
maria.g: Only L40S so far. H100 cluster hasn't shown it. Repro command: `./perf/run_inference --model gpt-j-8b --seq 1-2048 --batch 4 --qa --fp8=on --kernel-selector=dynamic-v2`
aj: thanks. What do profiles show?
maria.g: Quick flame: kernel switch churn increases, more time in `kv_load` and warp stalls during KV writes. Also seeing small spikes of L2 traffic.
dinesh: hmm — dynamic-v2 changed kernel ordering to prefer split-matmul kernels for medium seqs, right? That increases memory footprints per-stream and can bump eviction.
maria.g: exactly. The selector now picks split kernels at seq 512-1024 for L40S to match throughput modeled on H100. But L40S has different L2/SM balance so we end up with more KV cache evictions and increased PCIe->GPU copies in our private deploy tests.
tomo: do we have a simple repro that toggles only kernel-order?
maria.g: yes: two config snippets below — run with `--kernel-config <file>` to switch.

```
# config A (prod: dynamic-v1)
kernel_priority: ["fused_matmul", "split_matmul", "int8_matmul"]
use_kv_warmup: false
transformer_engine_flags: "TE_USE_SPLIT_KERNELS=0;TE_FP8_EMULATE=0"

# config B (canary: dynamic-v2)
kernel_priority: ["split_matmul", "fused_matmul", "int8_matmul"]
use_kv_warmup: true
transformer_engine_flags: "TE_USE_SPLIT_KERNELS=1;TE_FP8_EMULATE=0"
```

maria.g: With config B we see more frequent KV eviction logs: `KV_EVICT stream=3 size=2MB reason=mem_pressure`. That correlates with CPU-side retries and extra device memcpy.
aj: interesting. So dynamic-v2 assumed split kernels are cheaper overall but on L40S they increase working set. Two obvious mitigations: 1) prefer fused_matmul on L40S via hw-aware policy, 2) enable per-stream KV warmup and reserve a hot-spot allocation to avoid eviction.
dinesh: also check quant calibration. FP8 uses per-tensor scales by default; if we change to per-channel calibration the activation range can shrink and reduce intermediate buffers — that might change kernel memory. Have calibration results?
maria.g: ran short calib sets — switching to per-channel reduced peak activation by ~8% in layer 3..6 for this model. But hasn't been tested end-to-end.
tomo: can you paste the KV eviction log snippet and a small perf table?
maria.g: pasted below.

```
# perf median of 10 runs, 2x L40S, batch=4
config A (dynamic-v1): throughput=1260 tok/s, p50=85ms, p99=240ms
config B (dynamic-v2): throughput=1108 tok/s, p50=96ms, p99=272ms
KV logs (config B):
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] KV_EVICT stream=3 size=2.1MB reason=mem_pressure
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] KV_RELOAD stream=3 dur=1.7ms
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] MEMCPY_H2D size=2.1MB dur=2.3ms
```

aj: those reloads + memcpy explain the p99 bump. For L40S we should prefer fused kernels unless split gives >10% throughput. Maybe adjust selector to use hardware profile file.
maria.g: proposal: patch selector to include hw profiles mapping (L40S->fused_preference). Quick patch: add `hw_profile: {"L40S": {"prefer_split": false}}` and fallback by memory pressure counter.
dinesh: also add a KV watermark: if per-stream KV usage > 80% of reserved, throttle split-kernel choice.
tomo: agree. Also let's try calibration: run a small job that re-calibrates FP8 with per-channel scales and measure peak resident memory. If memory drops, we can keep dynamic-v2.
maria.g: I'll run two jobs overnight: (1) revert kernel priority for L40S; (2) keep dynamic-v2 but switch FP8 per-channel calib + KV watermark. Will post numbers tomorrow.
aj: canary rollout plan?
maria.g: if (1) fixes perf, we revert in canary and do a narrow A/B with dedicated pool for 48h. If (2) fixes, we keep dynamic-v2 but gate it by `hw_profile` for L40S.
perf-bot: scheduled perf-run id=pf_20260315_01 with configs [A,B] on pool l40s-canary, ETA 12h. Results will be auto-posted.
deploy-bot: note: PR #3241 linked; reverting requires PR #3250.
maria.g: action items: @aj update kernel-selector PR with hw_profile hook; @tomo run per-channel FP8 calibration and report peak resident memory; @dinesh add KV watermark check to selector; I'll monitor perf-bot results and paste logs.
aj: on it.
tomo: starting calib now.
dinesh: will prototype watermark today.
maria.g: thanks. If we hit >10% throughput loss on other models we may need a broader rollback. For now L40S-only tweak seems safest. :thumbsup:
